turns.text: Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did nobody call me first?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't the issue. Who decided?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Expected. So you'd already made up your mind about me too. Who decided, and on what basis?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side. You've dodged my question three times now. Who entered that zero?
